backfillRows.why: wg-batch-036 GAP LANE, sibling of the confirmed finding composer-staff-greater. SUPERSEDES (deletes) the shipped overlay row {category:'items',id:'composer-staff',field:'passiveEffects',value:{skills:{performance:1}}}; that object held the performance key and nothing else, so nothing survives to merge into this value. Print premise AoN equipment-2249 (Treasure Vault Remastered pg. 131), the base-staff paragraph the greater and major variants inherit verbatim: "In this way, you can play it as though it were an instrument, and it grants a +1 item bonus to Performance checks made with it." The bonus is for PLAYING the staff, not for holding it, but a held staff is `equipped`, so the flat field passed passiveItemBonus / passiveItemBonusDetail's itemInUse gate (derive.ts:303-322, :386-408) and raised every Performance check while the conditional star at src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1835 restated the same +1 beside it. The star stays and is the whole mechanic — the sibling instrument pipes-of-compulsion-greater is already star-only, and composer-staff-greater gets the identical row in work/.b036-rows-situational.json.

findings.note: No code change: the star already reads correctly and the registry entry is untouched. Deliberate divergence from WG, same as composer-staff-greater: WG encodes the +1 flat with the condition as display text; print scopes it to checks made with the staff.
